question.worked_solution:
We start with the ratio $8:24$ and write it as a fraction:

$$
\frac{8}{24}
$$

So the numerator represents the left-hand entry ($8$), and the denominator represents the right-hand entry ($24$).

Now we divide the numerator and the denominator by $8$ to find an equivalent ratio:

$$
\frac{8÷8}{24÷8}=\frac{1}{3}
$$

We can generate equivalent ratios by finding equivalent fractions:

- To create a numerator of $4,$ we multiply the numerator and denominator of our fraction by $4:$

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{1\times 4}{3\times 4}=\frac{4}{12}\end{aligned}
$$

- To create a denominator of $27,$ we multiply the numerator and denominator of our fraction by $9:$

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{1\times 9}{3\times 9} & =\frac{9}{27}\end{aligned}
$$

Finally, we fill in the ratio table:

| $4$ | $12$ |
| --- | --- |
| $8$ | $24$ |
| $9$ | $27$ |

$$
